description: Central Provident Fund (CPF) contributions are mandatory for employers hiring Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents.

wage_ceilings.additional_wage_ceiling_formula: $102,000 minus total ordinary wages for the year
wage_ceilings.description: CPF contributions are computed on wages up to these ceilings.

key_rules: CPF contributions are mandatory for all Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents earning more than $50 per month
For employees earning $50 to $500 per month, only the employer contributes (no employee share)
For employees earning more than $500 per month, both employer and employee contribute
Employer must pay CPF contributions by the 14th of the following month
Late payment incurs interest at 18% per annum (minimum $5)

pr_graduated_rates.description: SPR employees have graduated contribution rates during their first 2 years of PR status. Full rates apply from the 3rd year.
pr_graduated_rates.note: Employers and SPR employees may jointly opt for full rates from the start.
